designationHistory.name: Savannah River Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Calvin Coolidge created the Savannah River Bird Refuge by Executive Order 4626 on April 6, 1927, for the protection of native birds.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Savannah National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 5748, Nov. 12, 1931, Savannah River Wild Life Refuge (revokes "Executive Order No. 4626, dated April 6, 1927, creating the Savannah River Bird Refuge")
Wikisource: Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940 (renaming federal wildlife refuges; lists originating orders)

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date, EO number, signer and earlier name added from the recital in EO 5748 (Hoover, 1931), which re-established it as the Savannah River Wild Life Refuge.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Savannah National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1927 as a sanctuary for migratory birds, most notably wintering waterfowl.
